description: After telling a national cable audience that Mike Lawler was “scared” to face her, and that she would “kick [Lawler’s] ass”, Conley ducked Meet the Press and State of the Union, and stalled for 52 days to agree to just two debates, fewer than this district got in 2024 and none before September 28. Lawler has accepted four and is ready for all six. The candidates’ first forum is on Wednesday morning in Poughkeepsie and is open to the press.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lawler for Congress, Inc
title: CAIT CONLEY CHICKENS OUT OF BOTH NATIONAL DEBATES, HIDES UNTIL SEPTEMBER 28 - Mike Lawler for Congress
